worldcombat.skill.helpinghand.summary: Lend an ally a hand: send a small thread of light into them so their next hit lands harder; it is spent on that hit and fades if unused. Only a close enough ally can be helped.
worldcombat.skill.helpinghand.use.0: Make an ally's next big move heavier
worldcombat.skill.helpinghand.use.1: Set up before an ally's combo
worldcombat.skill.helpinghand.use.2: Turn one chance to hit into a knock-out
worldcombat.skill.helpinghand.descriptio: The ally's next hit deals %1$s%% more damage; the light lasts %2$s s.
Cast on an ally within about %1$s blocks; it cannot be used on yourself.
Preparation %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s from cast.
worldcombat.skill.helpinghand.stance.ral: Rally: bonus x1.15, but the light lasts only 65% as long and cooldown is +8 ticks — pour everything into one hit.
worldcombat.skill.helpinghand.stance.cal: Wait for the moment: the light lasts 1.5x as long and cooldown is -6 ticks, but the bonus is x0.9 - give the ally time to pick their opening.
worldcombat.skill.helpinghand.timing: Cast on an ally. After %1$s s of preparation it spends %3$s PP to lend the light, recovers %2$s s, and commits a %4$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.helpinghand.preference: On: assist bonus x1.15 but the light lasts only 65% as long and cooldown is +8 ticks, made for one decisive hit. Off: bonus x0.9 but the light lasts 1.5x as long and cooldown is -6 ticks, letting the ally choose their moment. Strength and window trade off.
Only lend to an ally within this distance; lower stays close, higher walks over to help.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to lend a hand.
worldcombat.skill.helpinghand.descriptio: The light is spent on the ally's next hit that deals damage; if the ally never lands one, it simply fades when it expires. Lending again only refreshes it, never stacks.
